Hi Sofia / Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week. We reviewed the draft marketplace SOW internally and procurement asked for two clarifications before we can route this to legal:

- A definitive billing contact and invoicing cadence for reserved SKUs (monthly vs. usage invoice).
- A completed SKU mapping file that ties your Redwood SKUs to our internal billing codes (so finance can validate tax/region allocations).

I’ve attached the Acme procurement template that highlights fields we’ll need on the DocuSign. Can you confirm who will be the Redwood billing contact and whether you support monthly invoicing?

Also, our GCP partner team will need a kickoff with your listing owner and your billing ops lead — can we aim for a short 30-min sync next week? Availability: Mon/Tue morning (PST) preferred.

Appreciate the quick turnaround; procurement has a soft target to close this by 12/20 so we can align co-sell planning.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
